remarks: Welcome to this exquisite top-floor penthouse-a rare corner residence bathed in natural light, offering breathtaking views & unparalleled Stamford living. With windows on three sides, each day starts with stunning sunrises in the living area and ends with magnificent sunsets from both bedrooms. Featuring spacious 2-bedroom, 2-bath accommodations, soaring 9ft+ ceilings, hardwood floors, & a smart open layout ideal for everyday comfort & entertaining. The expansive living & dining spaces, enhanced by custom automatic blinds, open seamlessly onto a private balcony with panoramic vistas. A stylish, windowed kitchen boasts stainless steel appliances, elegant cherry cabinetry, & a large-capacity built-in wine fridge-perfect for the wine aficionado. Relax in the serene primary suite offering ample closet space & a private en-suite bath. The second bedroom & bathroom are thoughtfully situated for optimal privacy, perfect for guests or a home office. Residents enjoy luxury amenities in this sought-after full-service building: doorman, on-site superintendent, state-of-the-art fitness center, community lounge, patio with grills, storage locker, covered garage parking, and guest spaces. With heating & cooling conveniently included in the HOA, comfort is effortless year-round. Ideally located steps from downtown Stamford's vibrant restaurants, shopping, nightlife, and Metro North train to NYC, this penthouse delivers sophisticated living at its best-unmatched location, lifestyle, & views.
